purpose: Dallas release-rehearsal QA for the complete personalized Gamecast chibi library: validate cold/warm load behavior, authoritative play replacement, personalized-layer degradation, signature eligibility, and visual identity invariants as one production-like end-to-end sequence before Dallas can be closed.

qualityContract.appearanceAuthority: current official headshot-derived appearance lock only; never infer skin tone, hair, facial hair, accessories, or other visible appearance from player name
qualityContract.identityAuthority: DAL/roster.json player slug plus current uniform number
qualityContract.failureBoundary: Personalized chibi failures are presentation-only. Authoritative NFL Gamecast event truth remains visible and usable, and no fallback may write into MLB or NHL state.

qaChecks.assert: A cold Gamecast start resolves Dallas roster identity, immutable asset version, approved appearance lock and eligible action before personalized playback; unresolved dependencies fall back without blocking Gamecast.
Warm-cache playback produces the same player identity, number, action eligibility, scale and foot anchor as cold-start playback for the same authoritative event revision.
A missing or failed personalized appearance asset never substitutes a teammate, archetype face, inferred skin tone, or name-derived appearance.
When an accepted play is replaced or corrected, obsolete personalized motion and football ownership are preempted before the corrected event is rendered.
Back-to-back plays involving different Dallas players reset scene ownership and anchors cleanly without leaking the prior player's pose, football, signature state or cache identity.
Runtime may consume only actions explicitly listed for that player in DAL/roster.json even if additional archetype assets physically exist.
Named signature playback requires both the verified player identity and qualifying authoritative event; generic celebrations never inherit a named signature.
A correction removing Lamb's first down or Miller's sack immediately cancels the corresponding named signature and cannot leave a stale completion state.
Every sampled base/action/signature transition preserves transparent alpha, canonical scale and foot-anchor tolerance through entrance, contact, celebration and recovery.
Reduced-motion presentation suppresses or shortens decorative movement while preserving identical player identity, event meaning, football ownership and signature eligibility semantics.
Reconnect reconstructs only the latest accepted authoritative revision and cannot replay already-consumed personalized actions/signatures from stale local state.
The complete Dallas release rehearsal performs zero mutation of MLB/NHL files, caches, routes, stores or runtime behavior.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: The same Dallas completed-pass event rendered cold and warm resolves the same receiver, current number, catch action, football owner, scale and anchor.
Simulated personalized appearance decode/provenance failure suppresses that chibi only; no guessed or teammate appearance is displayed.
Two consecutive authoritative plays led by different Dallas players do not share action state, anchor drift, football ownership or personalized cache identity.
A completed pass corrected to incomplete preempts catch/recovery motion and clears receiver football ownership before corrected presentation settles.
Requesting an archetype action absent from the player's roster inventory fails closed to an eligible generic/fallback presentation.
Authoritative CeeDee Lamb first down may route nose-wipe exactly once for the accepted revision; target-only, catch-short, duplicate poll and stale revision do not trigger it.
Authoritative Von Miller sack may route DeSoto Shuffle exactly once for the accepted revision; pressure-only, teammate sack, duplicate poll and stale revision do not trigger it.
Correction removing the qualifying Lamb first down or Miller sack cancels the named signature and prevents stale replay after reconnect.
A stale uniform-number asset is rejected rather than rendered for the correct slug with incorrect visible identity.
Representative offense, defense and specialist sequences remain transparent and return to canonical foot anchor without cumulative drift.
Reduced-motion run yields the same accepted event/player/football/signature semantics as full-motion run without requiring decorative animation completion.
Reconnect during rapid polling reconstructs only the newest accepted revision and does not replay consumed actions or signatures.
Executing all qa-06 fixtures requires no MLB/NHL code or data changes and produces zero cross-sport writes.

next: Continue Dallas QA with qa-07; do not begin Philadelphia until Dallas quality work is explicitly closed in project.json.
